structured_stats.description:
The '''Golden Crate''' is a crate that grants one of seven {{Color|Golden}} skins which come with a Golden Perk. It costs a colossal {{Coins|50,000}}, the single most expensive crate and item you can buy in the game with coins. Golden Perks make towers much stronger, but usually more expensive as well.

Each skin in this crate can appear in the daily skin store. Uniquely, unlike all other crates, each skin in this crate has its own cost. The {{Color|Golden}} [[Soldier]] skin costs {{Coins|50,000}}, the {{Color|Golden}} [[Scout]], {{Color|Golden}} [[Demoman]] and {{Color|Golden}} [[Crook Boss]] skins cost {{Coins|55,000}}, the {{Color|Golden}} [[Pyromancer]] costs {{Coins|65,000}}, the {{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] costs {{Coins|70,000}} and the {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]] costs {{Coins|75,000}}

related_pages.title: Crates
related_pages.wikitext_excerpt:
'''Crates''' ---- '''Crates''' in Tower Defense Simulator are items used to for the most part unlock '''Skins''' for [[towers]] and [[consumables]]. '''Crates''' can be bought with {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Robux|Robux}} or event [[currencies]], like {{Shards|Shards}}. Some '''Skincrates''' are event-exclusive, such as the [[Bunny Crate]] and the [[Spooky Crate]]. This means they cannot be bought after the event has ended. Some '''Skincrates''' can be obtained through [[Login Rewards]], [[Index]] or [[Passes]]. The [[Golden Crate]] also unlocks a Golden Perk along the {{Color|Golden|Golden}} skin, which affect multiple parts of the tower, mainly being its stats. Each '''Skincrate''' has specific skins that generally only they can unlock, with some exceptions. One '''Skincrate''' unlocks one skin and each '''Skincrate''' has a limited amount of skins to unlock. You can buy excess '''Skincrates''', though they cannot be opened. For '''Consumable Crates''', all of them share all or a portion of their consumables, though it is more likely to get consumables with higher rarity in higher tier crates. To open a '''Skincrate''', you must go into the ''Crates'' section of your inventory while in the lobby and open the crate in question. Using a '''Skincrate''' will randomly assign a skin that can be obtained from that crate to you. A specific skin for a specific tower cannot be chosen beforehand. You cannot get a skin for a tower that you do not own. If a player is from the Netherlands, Australia and Belgium, or if a player is in the United Kingdom and Brazil that cannot verify their age to be over 18, you will be able to see the order in which you unlock skins (or items you will get in the next crate) to comply with gambling laws.
'''Skins''' ---- '''Skins''' are just cosmetic overhauls of the [[Towers|tower]] in question, with no added bonus. Not all '''Skins''' can be found in '''Skincrates''' as some can only be obtained through different means, like a [[Codes|code]], such as the {{Color|Other|Spring Time}} [[Commander]] or from [[Passes]], such as the [[Duck Hunt Event#Skins|{{Color|Ducky|Ducky}}]] skins. To equip a skin, you must go into the ''Towers'' section of your inventory while in the lobby and select the specific tower you want to equip a skin for. Every skin has a rarity. For the skincrates that appear in the store, there are four rarities that they can have which determine how likely you are to unlock it. These rarities are {{Color|Common|Common}}, {{Color|Uncommon|Uncommon}}, {{Color|Rare|Rare}} and {{Color|Legendary|Legendary}}. For the [[Golden Crate]], they all use the {{Color|Golden|Golden}} rarity instead, making them all equal. Skins obtained directly from events and some seasons use the {{Color|Event|Event}} rarity, making them all equal. Skins obtained directly via Robux or from [[PVP]] rewards use the {{Color|Ultimate|Ultimate}} rarity. Other skins, such as code skins use the {{Color|Exclusive|Exclusive}} rarity. Skins that are in legacy crates from before 2023 also use the {{Color|Event|Event}} and the {{Color|Exclusive|Exclusive}} rarity. There are a few exceptions where a skin should have a {{Color|Event|Event}} or {{Color|Exclusive|Exclusive}} rarity, but it uses a different rarity instead. ---- {{Color|Common|Default}} {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:BasicSkincrateIcon.png|175px|link=Basic Crate]] |[[File:GoldenSkincrateIcon.png|175px|link=Golden Crate]] |[[File:ToySkincrateIcon.png|175px|link=Toy Crate]] |[[File:LovelySkincrateIcon.png|175px|link=Lovely Crate]] |- !Crate |[[Basic Crate]] |[[Golden Crate]] |[[Toy Crate]] |[[Lovely Crate]] |- !Cost |{{Coins|500}} |{{Coins|50,000}} |{{Coins|850}} |{{Coins|4,000}} |- !On Sale? |{{Color|Yes}} |{{Color|Yes}} |{{Color|Yes}} |{{Color|No}} |- ! |[[File:ColdFront

Gain cash every 8th shot.|Former Inventory Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden Cowboy''' is a golden perk for the [[Cowboy]], unlocked from the [[Golden Crate]] for {{Coins|50,000}}, if you have the [[Cowboy]]. It can also appear in the daily skin store for {{Coins|70,000}}. While initially it has a slow firerate, it deals moderate damage with a fairly low range. On later levels, the '''Golden Cowboy''' gains much higher damage, higher range and a faster firerate. The '''Golden Cowboy''' can also generate cash every sixth shot. The amount of shots needed for the '''Golden Cowboy''' to generate cash can be seen above its tower icon in the upgrade box or when you hover your cursor over it. After firing the last shot, it will spin its gun for a short while. The ''Spin Time'' is decreased at higher Levels. This ability can act as a primary or secondary source of economy. The '''Golden Cowboy''' is considered an all round tower. Its DPS makes it decent to defend early and mid-game, while its ability to generate cash can make it useful for the entire match. In comparison to its normal counterpart, the [[Cowboy]], the '''Golden Cowboy''' has higher damage, slightly higher range at Level 0 and it generates more money. It is, however, more expensive to place down and upgrade. The '''Golden Cowboy''' has a placement limit of twelve per player. ==Upgrades== {{Upgrade|Level = Level 1|Upgrade Title = Headshot Practice|Cost = {{Money|200}}|Image = [[File:Cowboy Upgrade 1 New.png|100px]]|Information = 0.9 > 0.75 Firerate [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]] +2 Range [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]] 2 > 1
